question: Does a film built ONLY from real public-domain archival images (photographs, period paintings, the real document) get more or less reach than our AI-still films posted the same day?
why_now: Owner model 11-22: the day sets the level and only FORMAT arms are left as levers; length arm shows viewers leave in the opening seconds whatever the length. Archival imagery is a format change aimed at the opening (the real ship, the real page). It also costs $0 in images while kie.ai is empty under the 11-24 cash wall (ask c886ec1b open).
design: A THIRD daily slot at 21:45Z (US afternoon; the existing slots are 01:45Z and 15:45Z and keep their pre-registered voice/opening pairs untouched). One archival film per day, 2026-11-26..2026-11-30 (n=5). Each archival film is compared with the MEDIAN of the same day's two AI-still films (UTC posting date).
films: 5 fresh subjects never filmed on Still Unsolved or By Claude, chosen before order; names prefixed 'pd'. Order = random.Random('archival-order-1127').shuffle over the alphabetical list. Same house shape otherwise: Atlas/onyx voice, long (~33-40 s), stamp end, old/sea/object/empty-place class.
metric: plays at 72h (lab.py report). Ratio r_d = archival / median(AI films of day d).
call_rule: median r >= 1.5 at n=5 -> archival WINS: make archival the default wherever the record has free images. median r <= 0.67 -> archival LOSES: back to AI stills. Otherwise TIE: still useful (free images at equal reach); keep as an option when image money is short.
harm_watch: Third film per day could cut the other two. Compare the AI films' 72h median on 11-26..11-30 with 11-21..11-25 (2/day) and page_total_media_view_unique per day. If the AI median drops below 0.67x of the prior 5 days AND page daily viewers do not rise, stop the third slot early.
known_confounds: slot: archival is always 21:45Z (all three slots are US waking hours)
frame: archival films may use band (16:9 photographs) while AI films are bleed (frame arm read tie: band 313 vs bleed 280.5)
subject: different subjects in every comparison (day effect dominates, model point 2)
voice: AI days 11-27..11-29 carry the voice arm (male/female); archival is always male
